Body and hair: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted build; an elegant low chignon with side-swept bangs; antique-gold hair.

House colours: fusion white, gold, pale violet, deep space blue.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow.
